body:
Part of #237. Owner product acceptance and closure remain open on that issue.

A delayed save or publish reply can arrive after navigation or newer edits. This change reconciles the list and editor against accepted saves, ties publication feedback to the exact immutable version stored, and preserves a newer device draft when the server published different content. An uncertain publish outcome survives local refusals; a deliberate retry checks the server before any new POST. Held input, save conflicts and changed editor generations are checked immediately before dispatch.

## Stack and current state

Draft head `1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9`, tree `2936f795e624932fd7d42747f8316066fa4af7ec`, is stacked on PR #474's branch at `ae8add8a791699e905540465b5ddf929d00c50eb`. Parent #273 must deliver first. This PR will be integrated and retargeted to actual main before final audit and merge; the parent is not claimed merged.

The independently observed runtime is `8fe52989`. Later publication `657fe51e` adds evidence, one guide paragraph and the raw-TSX QA formatting preservation rule. Integrating the parent at this head changes only documentation/evidence; product/test/configuration and bound guide bytes do not change in that merge. The [publication record](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-publication/README.md) and [parent integration proof](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-publication/parent-integration.json) distinguish those steps.

## Verification retained

- Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh owns the UI implementation. Phase 1 passed 866 focused tests, whole-web coverage of 2,529 tests (98.52% lines/94.03% branches), and 38 selected Edge cases. Those are historical phase-1 results, not current full CI. [Phase-1 evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-implementation/README.md)
- Independent native QA found two introduced retry gaps during implementation: state could change during awaited readback, then an intervening local refusal could erase the uncertain outcome. Both original failures, corrections and effective negative controls are retained. The final correction passed 33 publish tests and 262 affected tests, types/lint/formatting, and a forced 12-task build with zero cached tasks. [Integration correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-integration/README.md) · [Uncertainty correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-save-publish-uncertainty/README.md)
- Independent GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh native QA passed both uncertainty variants and 17 outcomes across publication, transport, list/detail, ancestry and refusal groups in actual Edge against compiled API main and disposable file SQLite. A lost committed reply caused zero repeat POSTs; an unadmitted request retried once only after readback. Exact immutable versions/pinned runs, newer edits, stale responses, real 409/422 refusals and device copies were checked. [Independent native report](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/1dcee36b16cc4662e8acb691e9166aff52949ad9/docs/qa/2026-11-14-publish-independent-corrected-native/README.md)
- All 12 fixture instances closed. Before/after bindings match 29 tracked source files, 12 bundled runtime sources and 1,227 build files across 13 trees; zero uncaught page errors. First fixture failures and corrections remain retained. The same-mounted recovery observation showed an older Publish pending while the loop queue prevented the restored draft's save; after settlement that draft saved and explicitly published. It does not establish a block on already-acknowledged newer work.
- All 465 new evidence files were checked against staged and committed Git blobs. Original raw logs, pre-correction conflict markers and source snapshots retain their bytes. The missing `docs/qa/**/*.tsx` formatter exclusion now implements the repository's existing raw-TypeScript preservation policy; product formatting, lint, coverage and test thresholds are unchanged.

Current-head CI is pending. Formal scans are 0/3: independent GPT UI review and fresh whole-PR Astra max audit remain required, with the three-total-scan cap preserved. No provider run, owner instance/store change, data migration or owner acceptance is claimed.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Track the actual merged build and observations on #237. Confirm that the saved/published distinction and later-edit notices are understandable during ordinary editing, that refusal and recovery wording clearly explains which copy is safe, and that navigation/list updates feel trustworthy. The pipeline separately verifies the machine-checkable behavior above.
